يجتذبان (form VIII)
# يَجْتَذِبَانِ (yajtaḏibāni) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ði.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يُجْتَذَبَانِ (yujtaḏabāni) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ða.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
